description: This file defines a helper class 'BlazorComponent' that extends 'ComponentBase' for Blazor applications. It manages refresh requests via a singleton 'RefreshBroadcast' and provides methods to trigger UI refreshes.

classes.name: BlazorComponent
classes.description: A helper base class for Blazor components that handles refresh events.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overrides the base method to subscribe to RefreshBroadcast's refresh requests.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Method to trigger a refresh request via the RefreshBroadcast singleton.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Handles the refresh event and calls StateHasChanged to update the UI.
